messages.author: 1f723d378f24adbb
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: cbind & rbind are named append_col & append_row
parts:
I am an R user and use Stan via rstan, but I prefer append_col and
append_row in Stan.

IMO many function names in R are accidental and occasionally not well
chosen (in particular, I very much resent the allocation c and t as
function names, which makes their use as single-letter local variables
bad style, if not exactly invalid). Also, while I am an "R user", I am a
C user, Julia user, and Lisp user too. So I don't see why Stan should
make an effort to follow any traditions of R when they are not the
optimal choice per se.

Best,

Tamas

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: cbind & rbind are named append_col & append_row
parts:
Our thinking exactly.

We should probably put more of our naming out to our
users group for feedback before locking it in. Some
things we obsess over on the dev list and wind up renaming
before release (like we changed "raise_exception" to "reject"
figuring it was more natural in the statistical setting, and
we changed solve_ode to integrate_ode to be more precise; I
was on the fence on both of those decisions).

- Bob
